text: Zither HarpHi, everyone.Nice to see you again.Do you remember the game, Who Am I?Now let's play the game.I'm from Greece.I work for the Greek army.I stayed in the forest with five other Greek soldiers.Who am I?Yes, I am one of the six Greek soldiers.In today's lesson, we will pretend to be one of the six soldiers and write about the experience.And we will learn how to add details to make our writing vivid.Since you are going to pretend to be one of the soldiers hiding inside the horse,let's take a quick review of the story, The Knight of the Horse.Answer the questions on the screen.Let's start with an easy one.How many soldiers were inside the horse?Six soldiers were inside the horse.Two, when did they climb out of the horse?An hour after midnight, they climbed out of the horse.Three, how did they open the secret door?They opened the secret door very quietly.Four, what did they do after climbing out?They opened the main gates of the city.The six Greek soldiers were brave, and their story deserved to be told to Greek people over and over again.Now imagine you were one of the six soldiers inside the wooden horse.After the war, your story was very popular.After telling it hundreds of times, you were asked to write about it.Before starting to write, you need to think about what to include in your writing.Which of them will you choose?The Knight of the HorseOf course, you were told the events you experienced.And the readers may have information gap.It's likely that they may have no idea of the children war at all.So it's a good idea to introduce the background at the beginning of your story to fill the gap.Since you are going to write mainly about your experience.I don't think it is necessary to write about the things you are not sure of.Like the events others might experience, or the purpose of other people's actions.And it's not a good idea to include too many thoughts or opinions about the children war.Since we've made up our mind, let's get started.First, let's complete the background information about the war and that knight.Take out your worksheet and finish task 1.Let's start.The Knight of the HorseThe Knight of the HorseThe Knight of the HorseLet's check the answers.We tried to capture Troy for 10 years but failed.And then we thought of a trick.We built a huge wooden horse and left it outside the main gates.Our army disappeared, but they didn't go far away.Then the Greeks saw the horse, but they didn't know that five other soldiers and I were inside the horse.When we write about our past experience, we should write it in the first person and in the past tense.After introducing the background information, you are going to write about events you experienced.Look at the seven events.Which of them will you choose and why?When I choose the events, I always ask myself whether I experienced them or not.In this case, I will not choose the first two events because when I was inside the horse, it was impossible for me to hear anything the captain and the soldier talked about.I can choose the first two events.I can choose number three because I could feel the horse moving when I was inside.Similarly, I could hear the children's citizens celebrating outside.I will definitely write about number five.That's the most important thing I did that night.And later I witnessed how our army captured the city of Troy.Do you agree with me?Now please write about the five events on your worksheet.Write one sentence for each event.Let's take a look at how my student Andy writes about events.The children dragged the horse inside the city.The children celebrated around the horse and made jokes about us.We opened the secret door and climbed out.We opened the main gates and our army entered the city.We seized the captain of Troy and won the war.Andy writes about the events in the first person and in the past tense.It's good that he mentions the children's jokes.Since the five events are organized in the time order,we can add adverbs,adverbial phrases or sentences to show their connection like this.That night, the children celebrated around the horse and made jokes about us.It tells us when the event took place.After the square was quiet,we waited for another hour to be sure.It tells us how careful the soldiers were.Then we opened the main gates and our army entered the city.Then it's used to show the order of the events.Of course,you can connect the events in many different ways.Among all of the five events you write about,which one of them would you like to rewrite with more details?I will choose the third event without hesitation,because it was something that I did myself and I feel proud of it.Now let's think about what details you can describe.It's very important to use your sense to help you.You can write about what you saw,what you heard,how you did something,how you felt,and what you or others said.Let's look at an example.How can we add details to this event?Since the square was quiet,I can say,I couldn't hear anything from the outside.That's what I heard.Our group leader said,let's wait one more hour.Just be sure that the Greeks all went to sleep.By writing about what the leader said,readers will have a better understanding of why they waited another hour.I felt nervous before opening the secret door.That's how I felt.I opened the door carefully,trying not to make any noise.That's how I opened the door.I saw the square was empty and the gates were not even guarded.That's what I saw.It's not that difficult to add details,right?Now let's have a try.Choose one of the events and add some details to it.Let's have a try.让我们看看Andy写的字那天晚上,孩子们在骑马上庆祝我听到他们在唱歌和跳舞后来我们听到他们在笑话我们并称我们为愚蠢的专家我非常生气专家领导说冷静,我们会让他们知道谁是愚蠢Andy写了他们听到的他感觉如何专家领导说细节是可信的我们也感到生气当我们的专家在笑话上笑让我们来做一个简短的总结当我们写写我们的过去的经历我们应该写在第一个人和过去的词上我们应该介绍背景我们在时间线中经历过的过去的经历不要忘了加上一些详细让你的写写更好现在,假设你就是孩子兵骑马的夜子写下你的经历在工作室上开始吧专家领导说冷静,我们会让他们知道谁是愚蠢Andy写了他们听到的专家领导说冷静,我们会让他们知道谁是愚蠢当我们在时间线中经历过的过去的经历我们应该介绍背景专家领导说冷静,我们会让他们知道谁是愚蠢Andy写下你的经历专家领导说揉成薄薄的一個圓圓的樣子然後用羊肉絲拉麵包倒入水中把羊肉絲拉麵包糠起來搓成粉狀加入鸡蛋加入白糖加入盐加入一勺盐倒入面糊倒入盐倒入盐倒入盐倒入盐倒入盐倒入盐倒入盐倒入盐倒入盐【翻译】再次,让我们结束这篇文章。在10年之内,英国人试图在城市上捕捉,但他们失败了。当天,当我在守护,我发现船和海是空的。我立即向船长报告。在城市的高速道路上,我们的船长告诉我们,我们赢了,而英国人把大马车转离了我们。我问他,为什么是车转离呢?我以为不简单,但船长刚刚让我把大马车转离了。我内心很生气,但当兵士时,我没有选择,而是遵守命令。Andy介绍了最初的背景资料。他告诉我们每一步的故事。他写下了他认为的,他向船长报告的,他说的,他认为的,他感觉的。你可以用这篇文章来测试自己的写文。我介绍了背景资料和提供的活动吗?我用了详细的文章吗?我希望你用不同的详细文章来令你的写文更有趣。这是你的家庭工作,下次见,拜拜!
